races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Adeel
runners_data.comment: Yard among the winners recently but this looks a hot contest in which to make debut
runners_data.spotlight: £42,500 yearling, £70,000 breeze-up 2yo; third foal; by Havana Grey; brother to 6f winner Tawasol (RPR 97); dam 6f winner (including 2yo/AW; 78), half-sister to 6f Group 3 winner Tabdeed; yard among the winners recently but this looks a hot contest in which to make his debut.

runners_data.name: Final Objective
runners_data.spotlight: 55,000euros yearling, £115,000 breeze-up 2yo; third foal; by Sioux Nation; closely related to 5f/6f AW winner Midnight Call (RPR 69); dam once-raced close relative of 6f 2yo Listed winner Cape Factor, half-sister to winners My Eyes Adore You (6f Listed) and Court House (smart 1m-1m4f); has a speedy pedigree and worth a market check; wears hood for debut.

runners_data.name: Rapid Deployment
runners_data.spotlight: 42,000gns yearling; first foal; by Zoustar; dam multiple 5f AW winner (including 2yo; RPR 104), half-sister to winners No Jet Lag (US 1m Grade 2) and Optari (French Group-placed 6f 2yo), out of 6f 2yo Listed winner; yard going well and 3-8 with their juveniles this year; likely contender on this debut.

runners_data.name: Rattenbury
runners_data.comment: Not ruled out on debut but he may well improve for the outing.
runners_data.spotlight: 62,000euros foal, 75,000euros yearling; fifth foal; Blackbeard half-brother to 6f AW winner Dyed In The Wool (RPR 74); dam 5f 2yo winner (76), half-sister to four winners out of US 6f stakes winner; not ruled out on debut but he may well improve for the outing.

runners_data.name: Storm Blade
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; by Night Of Thunder; brother to 6f/1m AW winner Storm Star (RPR 106), half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Planet Seeker (80); dam 6f/7f winner (including 2yo/Group 3; 113), half-sister to winners Foxtrot Lady (7f Group 3) and Dance Of Fire (useful 1m-1m2f including 2yo); yard going well and no surprise were he to feature on this debut.

runners_data.name: Bulletsnap
runners_data.spotlight: 85,000euros foal; second foal; by Minzaal; dam French Listed-placed 7.5f-8.5f winner (including 2yo/AW; RPR 93), sister to useful French 1m-1m4f winner Anobe, out of French 10.5f winning half-sister to prolific 7f-8.5f winner Vert Et Blanc; stable's second juvenile runner of the season; trainer  in great form so must be considered on debut.

runners_data.name: Mrair
runners_data.comment: Turned over at short odds on debut when runner-up at Newmarket; deserves another chance
runners_data.spotlight: Turned over at short odds on debut when runner-up at Newmarket (6f, good) 17 days ago where the Dip looked to put him out; nevertheless he still caught the eye and may warrant another chance with Ryan Moore on board.

runners_data.name: Rogue Imperial
runners_data.comment: Caught the eye on debut when fifth at Yarmouth 12 days ago; open to improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Caught the eye on debut when fifth of eight at Yarmouth (6f, good; 3-1) 12 days ago when, after travelling well, he looked to blow up; should benefit from the run and ought to go well.

runners_data.name: Blue Skies Above
runners_data.comment: Beat only one home on his debut at Kempton last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Beat only one home on his debut at Kempton (6f, AW; 11-2) last month; makes turf debut and needs to have come on leaps and bounds.

races.name: Follow @AtTheRaces On Instagram Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Perola
runners_data.note: Uncontested leader with recent wind surgery, needs to prove stamina over 7f after 91-day break
runners_data.comment: Placed on three of his 4 starts (3rd at Wolverhampton latest); below-par only turf start
runners_data.spotlight: Placed on three of his four runs, last time finishing third over 7f at Wolverhampton; has since had wind surgery; interesting, but was below par only previous run on turf.

runners_data.name: Star Banner
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type with most natural ability, shaped promisingly on debut despite greenness
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal of a 6f juvenile winner; shaped with promise when third in a Musselburgh novice 11 days ago (7f, good); bit green that day so should fare even better this time.

runners_data.name: Kennington
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse suited by return to turf, showed creditable form on all-weather track here previously
runners_data.comment: Creditable third in an AW maiden (1m) here on debut; should improve and worth considering
runners_data.spotlight: Creditable third in a 1m maiden on the AW here in April; should improve on that and worth considering.

runners_data.name: Chasse Patate
runners_data.note: Late-running type who impressed on debut, benefits from 7lb apprentice allowance in sprint finish
runners_data.comment: Running-on third at Kempton on debut 12 days ago; should improve; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Made late headway to take third in a Kempton novice on debut 12 days ago (7f; 28-1, Santiago Boy back in fifth); should improve; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Mythological Star
runners_data.note: Weak hold-up horse who fades in finish, likely outclassed by this better quality field
runners_data.comment: Didn't show a great deal on last month's Kempton debut (66-1) but is a likely improver
runners_data.spotlight: 19,000euros yearling; didn't show a great deal on last month's Kempton debut (66-1) but is a likely improver.

runners_data.name: Santiago Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner improving gradually, has clear form disadvantage with Chasse Patate from Kempton
runners_data.comment: Improved on debut when 3l fifth at Kempton latest; should improve again; each-way chance
runners_data.spotlight: Improved on his debut run when 3l fifth in a Kempton novice last time (7f, standard to slow; 125-1, bit to find with third-placed Chasse Patate); further progress likely; each-way chance.

runners_data.name: The Bureau Club
runners_data.note: Habitual slow starter with headgear, inconsistent form makes him hard to trust tactically
runners_data.spotlight: Habitual slow starter whose best effort by some way was when fourth in a Kempton maiden in March (1m); lesser efforts either side of that, including on turf debut at Salisbury last time (7f, good to firm; beaten 11.5l); bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Ocean Force
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse completely outclassed, carrying top weight as 5-year-old against 3-year-olds
runners_data.comment: Well beaten on his three starts to date (tailed off over C&D latest); hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten all starts so far, last time finishing 16l fifth of nine in a C&D novice; hard to fancy.

races.paceDynamic: Perola will lead uncontested from the gates with no other natural front-runners in this field, setting a comfortable sustainable tempo down the back straight. The large pack of hold-up horses (Star Banner, Kennington, Chasse Patate, Santiago Boy, The Bureau Club, Ocean Force) will settle behind in a bunched group, creating a tactical waiting game. This setup heavily favors prominent runners who can track Perola closely and hold-up horses with strong finishing kicks, as the lack of early pace pressure will create a sprint finish over the final 2-3 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Perola Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Perola maintains her lead turning for home without being challenged early
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader kicks clear in the straight before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenge. Her tactical advantage from wind surgery recovery proves decisive against this inexperienced field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays slow and multiple hold-up horses produce finishing kicks simultaneously
scenarios.body: The bunched field creates a cavalry charge in the final furlong with the best finisher prevailing. Star Banner's natural ability and recent promise gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one horse breaks from the pack to press Perola earlier than the rest
scenarios.body: An alert jockey positions prominently behind Perola then strikes at the 2f pole before others react. This tactical move catches the hold-up horses flat-footed in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Perola slows dramatically and no horse wants to take it on until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling tactical affair with a 1-furlong sprint where the horse with the best turn of foot wins. Raw ability trumps tactics in an extreme sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Perola's stamina over 7f after wind surgery and long absence could see her weaken dramatically in final furlong
Star Banner may show inexperience in a tactical finish if multiple horses challenge simultaneously
The Bureau Club's slow starting habit could leave him with impossible task if pace quickens earlier than expected
Watch Santiago Boy's position turning for home as he needs clear run from hold-up position to be competitive
Chasse Patate's apprentice jockey may struggle tactically if required to make split-second decisions in crowded finish

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap

runners_data.name: H Key Lails
runners_data.note: Front-runner whose 15 turf runs show just 3 wins and 6 places, returning from 86-day break to his weakest surface
runners_data.comment: 1-15 in this sphere and may be worth waiting until he returns to AW (six wins).
runners_data.spotlight: Races mainly on AW where he has six wins; 1-15 in this sphere and may be worth waiting until he returns to AW.

runners_data.name: Tattie Bogle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form with recent turf win at Musselburgh, consistent record suggests reliable effort likely
runners_data.comment: Won for the first time on turf at Musselburgh in April; runner-up at Ayr 12 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Has generally been consistent this year, winning for the first time on turf at Musselburgh (7f, good) in April; recorded a rare blip at Leicester last month but back on track when runner-up at Ayr (7f, good to firm) 12 days ago; respected.

runners_data.name: Dandy G Boy
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 168-day break with poor turf record (0 places from 5 runs), needs AW conditions
runners_data.comment: Won twice on AW for this yard last year; yet to be placed from five runs on turf.
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice on AW for this yard last year; yet to be placed from five runs on turf and runs off his highest mark; may be better for the run.

runners_data.name: Dutch Kingdom
runners_data.note: Front-runner whose 7 wins all came on AW, cheekpieces return but recent form dire for new connections
runners_data.comment: All seven wins have been on AW; best watched at present.
runners_data.spotlight: All seven wins have been on AW; yet to hit form in two runs for this yard; cheekpieces return but best watched at present.

runners_data.name: Rogue Dynasty
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who won turf debut at Chester and has been consistent since, 73-day break not excessive
runners_data.comment: Should be better for her reappearance at this track when fourth in March.
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark on her stable debut at Chester (7f, good) last July and has performed with credit on each run since bar a poor effort on soft at Sandown in August; should be better for her reappearance at this track (1m, AW) when fourth of six in March and holds claims in first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Portman Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making handicap debut with first-time tongue-tie, lightly-raced type with scope for improvement
runners_data.comment: Lightly-raced but beat only one home at this track in April on his handicap debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly-raced but beat only one home at this track (7f, AW) in April on his handicap debut; a first-time tongue-tie is fitted and still has time on his side.

runners_data.name: Ironist
runners_data.note: Prominent type who prefers softer conditions, recent consistent form but needs rain to arrive for optimal chance
runners_data.comment: Consistent sort who got off the mark at Yarmouth off 2lb lower last September.
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent sort who got off the mark at Yarmouth (6f, soft) off 2lb lower last September; respectable efforts since and if the rain arrives then that will enhance her claims.

runners_data.name: Amused
runners_data.note: Prominent French import with visor fitted, recent seller form suggests this class level may stretch his ability
runners_data.comment: Won when trained in France last August; finished last on return in April.
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French gelding who was unraced at two; made all to land Vichy claimer (very soft) in August and went mighty close for this yard in Leicester seller (good) in October; 25-1 and raced wide before solid fifth of 12 at Kempton (also 7f, AW) in December; showed no improvement in first-time cheekpieces when last of ten on his return at Epsom (8.5f, good) in April and visor returns; best left alone at present.

runners_data.name: Big Alex Walmsley
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 236-day break after gelding operation, hard to fancy on recent form
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced but well held in handicaps on his last two runs.
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced but well held in handicaps on his last two runs; has been gelded since and returns from a break of 236 days; hard to fancy.

races.paceDynamic: H Key Lails and Dutch Kingdom will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set honest fractions over the 7f trip. Four horses (Tattie Bogle, Dandy G Boy, Ironist, Amused) want prominent positions behind the leaders, creating inevitable congestion and traffic problems entering the straight. The sustained pace from two willing leaders will stretch the field and expose stamina, clearly favouring hold-up horses who can finish strongly through tired legs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If H Key Lails and Dutch Kingdom engage in a genuine speed duel from the gates
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will string out the field and create perfect conditions for late runners to pick up the pieces. Rogue Dynasty and Portman Blue can exploit their hold-up styles to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is more measured with Dutch Kingdom or H Key Lails controlling tempo
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows prominent runners to stay closer and kick clear before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. Tattie Bogle and Ironist benefit from their tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Leaders Survive
scenarios.trigger: If H Key Lails finds his AW form translating to turf with Dutch Kingdom fading early
scenarios.body: The class front-runner gets an easy lead when his main pace rival disappoints, allowing him to dictate terms throughout. His proven stamina at the trip becomes the decisive factor.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet creates a wall of horses causing multiple interference incidents
scenarios.body: The pace collapses due to tactical bunching, allowing an outsider with a clear passage to capitalize on the chaos. Big Alex Walmsley's hold-up style gives him the best position to avoid trouble.

watchPoints.text: H Key Lails and Dutch Kingdom will both want the early lead, creating potential for unsustainable fractions that collapse both horses
Traffic problems are inevitable with Tattie Bogle, Dandy G Boy, Ironist and Amused all wanting prominent positions behind the leaders
Portman Blue's first-time tongue-tie and light racing experience could unlock improvement on handicap debut
The 168-day and 236-day breaks for Dandy G Boy and Big Alex Walmsley respectively suggest both need the run
Any late rain would significantly enhance Ironist's chances given his preference for softer ground conditions
